# `APPLY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Apply (`APPLY_`)](README.md#domain-apply) |
| Reported by | `cli`, `plugin` |

## What happened

The config requires an IR feature the plugin does not support (CLI), or a bundle lists a required feature the plugin does not know (plugin, [02 §4.3](../../internal/plan/02-architecture.md#protocol)).

## What to do

Update the Figma plugin, or turn off the feature in config.
